content.text: In a digital landscape where platforms like Stripe and PayPal often exclude creators in regions such as Nigeria and Venezuela, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-until-2|Do Not]]ing your own crypto store can seem daunting. However, with COREMERCH’s [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-2|infrastructure]], you can deploy a fully functional online store using Cloudflare Pages, allowing you to accept cryptocurrency payments seamlessly. This guide walks you through the steps to get your store live without the restrictions of conventional payment processors. Let's get [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-step-step-16|COREMERCH guide to start]]ed on leveraging sovereign digital commerce to empower your creations.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators based on geographical restrictions, making it difficult to monetize digital products effectively. COREMERCH's infrastructure is built on decentralized principles, allowing you to take control of your commerce without reliance on external platforms. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you establish a resilient framework that grants you autonomy over your business. This approach not only mitigates the risks associated with platform failures but also ensures that your financial transactions are secure, efficient, and free from unnecessary fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin the deployment process, gather the essential tools and assets required for your crypto store. You'll need a domain name, access to Cloudflare, and a GitHub account for hosting your pages. Additionally, prepare your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates, ensuring they are ready for seamless delivery. Familiarize yourself with the NOWPayments integration process, as this will be crucial for setting up your payment system. Lastly, have your branding materials ready to create a cohesive and professional look for your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment pipeline, start by configuring your NOWPayments account. Create an API key and link it to your Cloudflare Pages setup to initiate crypto payment processing. Next, utilize Google Apps Script to automate the backend logic for order management and product delivery. This ensures that every transaction is processed swiftly, with product links sent automatically to buyers upon confirmation. By following these steps, you establish a robust delivery mechanism that guarantees your customers receive their purchases instantly while maintaining full ownership of their data.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery systems are in place, it’s time to go live. Push your code to GitHub and ensure that your Cloudflare Pages site is correctly configured to display your products. Conduct a test transaction using a small crypto payment to verify that everything functions as expected. Monitor your dashboard for order confirmations and ensure that the automated delivery process operates smoothly. This first transaction is a significant milestone, confirming that your infrastructure is live and that you can successfully sell digital products online.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your crypto store live, focus on scaling your operations. Begin by adding more digital products to your catalog and consider leveraging the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced functionality. This upgraded infrastructure allows you to load up to five products, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for improved email verification, and gain access to 30 days of support. As your sales grow, continuously analyze customer feedback to optimize your offerings and explore additional marketing channels to reach a wider audience. This proactive approach will help you sustain growth without relying on external platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Building a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free involves setting up a combination of Cloudflare Pages, NOWPayments, and automated delivery systems via Google Apps Script. You can deploy Stack 01 in a matter of hours, or opt for Stack 02 which is end-to-end tested and ready in 48 hours for a more robust setup.
Experience seamless crypto payments without KYC hassles.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re interested in more advanced features, consider exploring the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). This solution builds upon the foundation laid in this guide, enhancing your store's capabilities while ensuring effortless crypto payment processing. For direct access to products, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register a domain name and create a GitHub account. Set up your Cloudflare Pages and connect it to GitHub. Prepare your digital products for upload. Configure your NOWPayments account and obtain your API key. Write Google Apps Script to automate product delivery. Test your store by processing a small crypto transaction. Launch your store and monitor transactions for smooth operation.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a free digital store accepting crypto payments, use Cloudflare Pages for hosting, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing, and automate delivery with Google Apps Script. This setup allows complete ownership and control over your store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 offers more features, supports five products, and is end-to-end tested before deployment.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced functionality, especially when integrated with other services like NOWPayments.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5%. It requires no KYC and supports automatic payment confirmation, making it a great choice for creators.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Stack 02 can be deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, ensuring that your digital store is fully functional and ready to process transactions.
